name: transition_selected_object_color

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_TransitionSelectedObjectColor consumes five values and queues a type-23 COLOR_CHANGE operation for the selected object

notes: ScriptCommand_TransitionSelectedObjectColor normalizes the red, green, and blue values by 255 and the alpha value by 128, then packs the duration into the operation record. The object-operation dispatcher installs those transition values and sets the color-override flag at object offset 0x370. Command 91 restore_selected_object_default_color clears that flag. The JP corpus contains 190 calls; all 49 command 91 calls follow this command within three instructions.
